hard_limits: The 1960 Code/1962 printed Missal prevail over institutional explanations and computed calendars.
FSSP supports seasons; ICKSP serves chant texts; SSPX API is comparative and defaults to French SSPX calendar.
Never import pre-1955 Holy Week materials as ordinary printed 1962 rubrics.
Local calendar/permission and explicit following-action state are required for processions, exposition, absolution, Mandatum and external solemnity.
No source route certifies a question's theological or ceremonial answer; perform exact passage collation before publishing.
Do not create 170 new glossary objects or duplicate existing calendar rules.
Do not redistribute whole secondary source text or API dumps without permission.
This crosswalk does not certify the image exists in the church photograph.
